data.summary:
Microsoft 365 Developer and SharePoint Administrator with 3.7 years of experience in SharePoint Online, SharePoint Server 2016, SPFx, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Nintex, Nintex Automation Cloud, ShareGate, PnP PowerShell, and REST API integrations.
Experienced in SPO tenant administration, governance reporting for 20,000+ SharePoint Online sites, SP2016 production support, and SharePoint customization using SPFx web parts.
Worked on SPFx solutions by developing modern client-side web parts, integrating SharePoint lists and libraries, consuming REST API data, customizing UI components, and supporting deployment activities in SharePoint Online.
Also experienced in Canvas App development, approval workflow automation, Power BI dashboards, migration validation, and legacy Nintex workflow modernization to NAC.
Skilled in role-based access control, site permissions, form validation, UAT coordination, production troubleshooting, and delivering secure Microsoft 365 business solutions.

responsibilities: Translated 12+ legacy Nintex workflows into NAC cloud workflows by analyzing on-premises logic, approval paths, email actions, task assignments, and escalation rules.
Configured NAC approval workflows for 8+ business process scenarios, including routing, reminders, notifications, document updates, and SharePoint Online task management.
Delivered 4+ Power Apps Canvas App modules connected with SharePoint Online for request tracking, business forms, approval screens, and process automation.
Produced 10+ Power Automate cloud flows for approval handling, automated status updates, email communication, and structured workflow execution.
Integrated SharePoint Online list data with Power Apps forms, workflow screens, and business process tracking modules for controlled user actions.
Enhanced SharePoint Online user experience using SPFx UI components, REST API integration, and modern page customization where required.

Coordinated requirement gathering, SIT, UAT, deployment validation, and post-release support for 6+ SharePoint, Power Apps, and NAC enhancements, reducing release defects through structured validation.
Prepared workflow mapping documents, deployment notes, validation reports, and functional handover details for business and support teams.
Managed tenant-level SPO governance and reporting activities across 20,000+ SharePoint Online sites, including storage, site status, templates, ownership, and permission insights.
Completed pre-migration analysis, permission review, metadata validation, broken link checks, and post-migration verification for 50+ sites, lists, and libraries.
Converted selected Nintex forms and workflows into Power Apps and Power Automate solutions to align legacy processes with Microsoft 365 standards.
Deployed Power Apps Canvas Apps with SharePoint Online backend lists for approval forms, request tracking, user input validation, and status management.
Built Power Automate flows for approvals, reminders, email notifications, item updates, scheduled reporting, and business process automation.
Formulated SPFx SharePoint Online enhancements using React.js, TypeScript, REST APIs, and PNP JS to improve modern page functionality and user experience.
Provided 5+ lightweight SPFx web parts and UI customizations to display SharePoint list data, status indicators, quick links, and business-specific content, improving page usability for end users.
Customized modern SharePoint pages, list views, and JSON formatting to improve navigation, usability, and information visibility for business users.
Built Power Automate communication flows using dynamic HTML and CSS email templates to support campaigns for 30K–70K+ users per wave.
Added wave scheduling and out-of-office handling logic in communication flows, improving campaign delivery success by approximately 15%.
Designed Power BI dashboards using PowerShell-generated data to report SharePoint site details, storage usage, templates, custom script status, and permission insights.
Streamlined governance reports through PNP PowerShell, reducing recurring manual reporting effort by nearly 50%.

Assisted in SharePoint 2016 patching, cumulative update deployment, hotfix validation, and production support activities by coordinating pre-checks, service verification, post-patching validation, and issue troubleshooting to ensure platform stability and minimal business impact.
Administered SharePoint Online and SharePoint Server 2016 sites by handling access requests, permission changes, list settings, library configuration, and user issues.
Resolved 1,500+ SharePoint-related incidents covering permissions, site access, document library issues, workflow errors, configuration defects, and support requests.
Executed ShareGate migration tasks from SharePoint 2016 to SharePoint Online, including source analysis, content movement, validation, and issue remediation.
Constructed basic Nintex forms and workflows in SharePoint 2016 lists to automate approvals, document routing, email notifications, and task assignments.
Supported Power Apps form customization activities by updating fields, validations, SharePoint list connections, screen layouts, and user input behavior.
Assisted in Power Automate flow updates for approval routing, email alerts, item status updates, and recurring business notifications.

Developed client-side SPFx web parts and extensions using React and TypeScript, optimizing REST API data fetching, configuring custom list layouts, and troubleshooting JavaScript execution bugs on modern SharePoint pages.
Implemented JSON formatting and front-end enhancements across 25+ SharePoint list views and modern pages, improving data visibility, navigation, and user interaction.
Authored PowerShell scripts for tenant-level reporting across SharePoint Online and Exchange, including site templates, read-only sites, custom script-enabled sites, mailboxes, and delegated access.

Improved information architecture by reorganizing navigation, cleaning outdated content, and reviewing permission inheritance across 50+ SharePoint sites, reducing access-related issues and improving content discoverability.

raw_sections.summary: Summary Microsoft 365 Developer and SharePoint Administrator with 3.7 years of experience in SharePoint Online, SharePoint Server 2016, SPFx, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Nintex, Nintex Automation Cloud, ShareGate, PnP PowerShell, and REST API integrations. Experienced in SPO tenant administration, governance reporting for 20,000+ SharePoint Online sites, SP2016 production support, and SharePoint customization using SPFx web parts. Worked on SPFx solutions by developing modern client-side web parts, integrating SharePoint lists and libraries, consuming REST API data, customizing UI components, and supporting deployment activities in SharePoint Online.
